# Gallery

`gallery.yaml` lists the photos on the Gallery page, each under its number
(idx), and `photos/` holds the photos themselves. Higher numbers are newer and
come first. The square thumbnails in the grid are
**generated by the build** from each photo, so you never make them yourself.

## Add a photo

1. Put the photo in `photos/`. Use a straight-from-the-camera original; the
   pre-commit hook shrinks it to 2560px and removes EXIF (including GPS
   location) when you commit.
2. Add it at the top of `gallery.yaml` with the next number (highest + 1),
   and a blank line before the next photo:

   ```yaml
   46:
     file: 26_aiconnect.jpg
     caption: AI Connect Korea 2026 - IITP President's Award
     alt: Kwanhee receiving the IITP President's Award at AI Connect Korea 2026
   ```

| Field | Required | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `46:` (the key) | yes | The photo's idx. Sets the order: higher is newer. Never reuse one; to reorder two photos, swap their numbers. |
| `file` | yes | File name in `photos/`. Lowercase, no spaces. |
| `caption` | yes | Shown when hovering a tile, and under the photo when opened. |
| `alt` | no | Description for screen readers, if it should differ from `caption`. |

The Members page shows the first few photos as a preview, and the photo viewer's
previous/next buttons follow the same order. Both update automatically.

## Thumbnails

The build crops each photo to a centered square (`thumbnail.size` px) and saves
it as `stories/thumbs/<name>.jpg` in the built site. If a crop cuts off what
matters, crop the photo itself before adding it.

## Presentation settings (`config.toml`)

| Setting | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `thumbnail.size` / `thumbnail.quality` | Thumbnail size in px / JPEG quality |
| `preview.count` | Photos per page in the Members page preview |
